answer: A hostile operator running 175 aliases as a result needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in cipher, expire in gale, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1176 identities would post 3380 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
